items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee discusses Buster Bailey's reputation, his relationship with Charlie Parker, and his role in Benny Carter's band, but does not describe a direct personal or professional interaction between himself and Buster Bailey.

ctx.x: Buster was another one who could play like mad.
Buster is the guy, the only guy that Charlie Parker looked up to. I know
a guy asked him, who is the best saxophone, Buster Smith, the greatest in the world. But he was so unassuming and just a wonderful guy, it was such a relief that he didn't drink, very quiet.
